correctness.rationale: An induction on strict upper diagonal distance proves q-free-parameter idempotent fiber sizes for every prescribed binary diagonal, including characteristic two; the generation iff criterion follows from diagonal interpolation, adjacent two-by-two quotients and lifting complete diagonal idempotents in the generated algebra. The two lemmas give the displayed multiplicative weighted sum over all injective diagonal word lists. Literal independent exhaustive computations over q=2,3,4 and small dimensions, with direct finite-field linear algebra, agree. Higher special polynomial identities follow from exhaustive symbolic word-grouping by polynomial coefficients as implemented in the standalone checker; no finite-field test is represented as the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The 1998 full text establishes sharp generator-number thresholds and constructive arrangements, but does not derive ordered finite-field generator-tuple counts. The 2024 accessible abstract extends minimum numbers to incidence algebras. The 2020 counting paper counts individual potent matrices; the 2025 generating-probability article counts tuples of unrestricted matrices. The Hamming-weighted enumeration for simultaneous idempotent generation is not an immediate substitution into those results. Searches found no exact dominating result; priority remains provisional due chiefly to inaccessible Kolegov (2024) full text and possible broader incidence-algebra enumerators.

value.rationale: Exact number/probability of idempotent generating tuples is a natural invariant refining the classical 1998 minimum number, with nontrivial dependence on Hamming distance across all pairs and on adjacent radical indecomposables. The theorem yields exact all-size/all-field counts rather than a one-off small exercise, distinguishes alphabet and matrix-size regimes, and can support random idempotent-generation studies in finite matrix/incidence algebras.
